author: EvilCupCake47
body: It really depends on what you are going for. TWisp will for sure help with staying alive and is probably the better choice 90% of the time. War Horse though, I think is best used during a raid. Getting Def double down on a raid boss and going to town on them is a great feeling that can’t be beat. Of course, you have to survive long enough to proc it. It’s a conundrum haha

author: JunkmonkeyZr0
body: It all depends on class.  Most people at tier 7 would go for Twilight Wisp and complain it doesn't heal them as often.  War Horse is really good for doing damage but really now at to heal unless you yourself have taken Wisp Heal 2 to balance out.  For tamer builds, it's better to go War Horse and heal yourself.  The horse will do the damage for you.  But at tier 7, I recommend getting this month's pet if you're a tamer build.  If not, it's nice to have a fat green worm in your keep, but stick to healing yourself with pets if you're not a tamer.
